definition: Aidan Gomez is a British-Canadian computer scientist working in the field of artificial intelligence, with a focus on natural language processing.
details: He is the co-founder and CEO of the technology company Cohere.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. And that is Aidan Gomez — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
